verdict.rationale: Devin ships an officially documented Devin CLI, described as a local command-line coding agent. It is invoked from the terminal (e.g. `devin -- check out this code...`) and can run with OS-level sandbox isolation via the --sandbox flag. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the local CLI experience (community evidence only covers the cloud product).

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal

citations.quote: Devin CLI, a local command-line coding agent with deep Devin Cloud integration.
devin -- check out this code and suggest a feasible, helpful feature
The --sandbox flag runs the CLI with OS-level isolation, enforcing writable paths and deny rules at the operating-system level
Hand a task off to a cloud Devin session and keep working locally.
